news.summary: Anthropic's Claude Code AI tool has boosted its engineering organization's productivity to three times its actual headcount, forcing the company to hire more product managers to decide what to build. news.summary_raw:

The post Talos: Scaling rare disease diagnosis with automated, iterative genomic reanalysis appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Talos is an open-source system developed by Microsoft Research to speed up rare disease diagnosis through automated genomic reanalysis. It recovers 90% of in-scope diagnoses with minimal expert review.
